'''Shewski Jabba's New Bodyguards (COURT)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Shewski]]
* '''Published:''' 27 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / Vile Gangsters|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Gangster}}
* '''Strategy:''' Court Of The Vile Gangster
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 Vile Shewski DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck aims to use COTVG to force the opponent to come to you on Tatooine, and then use the hired muscle of the Tusken Raiders to rough up your opponent.  TEST

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

First you need to secure the Audience Chamber- First turn deploy Mighty Jabba to AC using it's game text then use Power of the Hutt to deploy Ephant Mon with his buddy.

Hopfully, your opponent will not deploy to Tatooine to play it safe (and due to the extra costs).  Next turn, you want to get Taym to the AC using Bantha Fodder and pull Boelo using POTH.

Use the sites to drain with Tuskens, support them with Banthas, the Herd, and Gaffi sticks, which can be recycled with Inconsequential losses.

Whenever you opponent deploys to counteract the Objective, battle so you can retreive force with S & V.

I don't know if this will work, but I always wanted to make a Tusken Deck.  I need to add a Tatooine Occupation (Once I get one) but other than that, I am merely taking advantage of the Obj to try and arrange some beatdowns.  I also don't have EPP Fett, or RefIII Fett, or else they would make appearances on the ground.  SE Jabba I would include instead of Mighty to help against choke decks, but I don't have him either.

Card Choices- I think the rest are self-evident

COTVG v MKOS
The big debate in my head.... I can retrieve my Tuskens, but what sold me for COTVG was the ability to encourage the LS to come to Tatooine.  Hopeflly it works!

Krayt Dragon Bones: I think this is a fun little card that can be aided with Taym at the Chamber.

Advisors are there to get out that pesky site/effect that I am missing.  It is mostly in there for Tatooine, so I can avoid Battle Plan taxation.


Any comments are greatly appreciated!
